data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (origin, destination, dates, optional points, Search flights, Continue to flight results, Sort & Filter, sort, Apply) and names nearly all the parameters, but it hard-codes "lowest price" while also listing sort_option, and it adds an "open jetblue.com" step; it also leaves the exact sort option label ("Price by Core") and the points toggle vague.
